# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Confirmed the hourly photosynthesis-to-growth carbon-credit reconciliation is already present on the DIC path, then retuned the shipped `medium_planted` startup path so each selected plant guild starts at 6 g (12 g total in the default scenario) and updated the scenario note to match. I also fixed stale `tank_data`/`tank_scenarios` source-water assertions that incorrectly expected the shipped `ro_like` profile to materialize at neutral pH; the regressions now assert it remains the most acidic shipped profile while staying inside the carbonate bounds. The previously flagged `nitrification_lowers_alkalinity_and_ph` test now passes on current HEAD without further code changes.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the pending amendments against current HEAD, confirm the hourly DIC growth-credit fix is already in place, and reproduce the shipped `medium_planted` and nitrification regression behavior.
2. [Completed] Retune shipped `medium_planted` materialization/startup handling so the scenario still shows the required day-night pH separation after the carbon-credit cap, and update the scenario provenance note to match the new 12 g starting plant load.
3. [Completed] Replace stale RO-like neutral-pH assertions in `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` with checks that match the shipped acidic profile, then rerun the targeted validation suites including the nitrification regression.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test photosynthesis_dic` passed (9 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test plant_algae_integration` passed (15 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test chemistry -- --exact nitrification_lowers_alkalinity_and_ph` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_data` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- I did not run the full workspace test matrix; validation stayed focused on the DIC/photosynthesis path plus the scenario/data suites touched by the regression fixes.
- The worktree already contains unrelated uncommitted changes outside this diff; I left them untouched.
